formula: z = where(a>0, stopgrad(zKgeometry) + a*sigmoid(g(u))*2*tanh(r(u)), stopgrad(zKgeometry)); q=sigmoid(z)
availability: a=raw supported N feature X12 before residual active/constant masks; query-invalid implies a=0
availability_control: 8..11 zero; original8 geometry and X12 structural support flag retained, identical gate/mask/parameters/forward as material
material: All13 existing supported-rank N features; no new image/label/descriptor/bank/normalization fit
ordinal_material: Pre-registered secondary same-capacity variant:8/10/11zero, rank9 and support12 retained with original8 geometry; addresses absolute material-scale transport without target fitting
frozen_anchor: Per-seed K geometry checkpoint; original13->32->16->1, only0..7 active with its original constant coordinates; 993 frozen parameters

gate.interpretation: learned gate weight, not a calibrated correctness probability

capacity.deployment_note: Three composite anchor+gate+residual auxiliary networks plus existing Ebase3; six files is not a claim of identical capacity to old single-branch K/N

training.source_balance: 9790 multinomial tuple draws per source, 29370 total; per-source weights1/(image proposalcount*classcount), shared generator and permutation seed
training.paired_views: Two identical clean views, same mean objective, one step
training.early_stop: Same source/image/tuple-balanced validation weightedBCE without residual penalty
training.initial_anchor_candidate: Epoch-1 with exactzero correction is saved before training and retained if no >1e-6 improvement
training.normalization: Variant-specific exactconstant columns fitted only on unique training tuples, no fitted means/std

numerics: Deterministic GPUF32 anchor/gate/residual and logits, TF32 disabled, CPUF32 sigmoid; caller combines all3 seed results in F64 then castsF32
required_protocol_fields: cases[CASE].N_feature_manifest ref to immutable N feature manifest
cli_train: python -B scripts/train_models.py train --protocol P --protocol-sha256 SHA --variant availability_control|material|ordinal_material --seed 17|29|43 --output-dir OUT/models/VARIANT/seedSEED --device cuda:0
cli_infer: python -B scripts/train_models.py infer --protocol P --protocol-sha256 SHA --case CASE --checkpoint OUT/models/VARIANT/seedSEED/model.pt --output-dir OUT/inference/CASE/VARIANT/seedSEED --device cuda:0
